subject: Boost Lock in Revenge?
author: ZombieTron
body:
I don't think I ever remember getting Boost Lock in Revenge, but it was definitely in Burnout 3.

Getting Boost Lock on the Blue Team in Road Rage was cool! Evened out the playing field, at least until I crashed and lost it!!!

Ofcourse the Red Team with infinite boost had an effective Boost Lock too, so the Extreme Hot Rod isn't the first time we have seen Boost Lock in Burnout! 🙂

subject: Boost locked?

body:
